why: A security alert with a reset link is not a sign-in code to hide.

mail.subject: Security alert: new sign-in on Windows
mail.body: A new sign-in to your account. If this wasn't you, reset your password now: https://accounts.google.com/reset?token=abc123

why: A failed payment with a billing link is loud.

mail.subject: Payment failed: Clayworks Supply invoice #5521
mail.body: Your payment failed. Update billing: https://dashboard.stripe.com/billing?token=xyz789 or your account will be paused.

why: A paused store with a one-click link is loud.

mail.subject: Your store has been paused
mail.body: Your payment method expired and your store is paused. Fix it here: https://marlow.myshopify.com/admin/settings/billing?code=5541

why: A plain sign-in code is private and stays quiet.

mail.subject: Your sign-in code
mail.body: Your verification code is 482913. It expires in 10 minutes.

why: A reset link the user just asked for is private and stays quiet.

mail.subject: Reset your password
mail.body: You asked to reset your password. Open https://acme.example/auth/reset/abc123 to choose a new one.
